text:
micah: quick sync — trying to get zh-30b-mqa v2 ready for Dedicated onboarding. can folks sanity-check weights location, tokenizer mapping, and runtime config? noticed RoPE scaling mismatch in the early smoke runs.
ashok: I pulled the model metadata yesterday. weights are at s3://ri-models/zh/30b/mqa/v2/ (sharded, idx-000..idx-015). also uploaded tokenizer files under s3://ri-models/zh/30b/mqa/v2/tokenizer/ - vocab.json merges.txt.
eva: saw the same. tokenizer has an extra BOS token mapping compared to our standard zh-30b template — start_token id=1 vs id=0. will align and open a registry PR. :eyes: 
jo: on the runtime side, the default config in model-registry has rope_scale: 1.0 but our runtime selects rope_scale=0.95 for other zh variants. that could explain divergence in attention patterns. also attn_impl is set to "flash" in the model.yaml but the Dedicated nodes fallback to "cuda_fallback" for some kernels.
micah: can you paste the model.yaml snippet?
jo: sure:
```
model:
  name: zh-30b-mqa
  schema_version: 2
  attn_impl: flash
  rope_scale: 1.0
  gqa: true
  sliding_window: 2048
  kv_cache_shards: 16
```
ashok: runtime check output from ri-check-model-config: 
```
INFO: validating model files at s3://ri-models/zh/30b/mqa/v2/
WARN: tokenizer.vocab maps BOS->1 (expected 0)
ERROR: attn_impl mismatch: runtime supports [flash, cutlass], node fallback set to cuda_fallback
ERROR: kv_cache_shards mismatch: model metadata=16, runtime expected divisor of 32
```
eva: I'll fix the BOS id in tokenizer and add a compatibility shim for merges order. PR will include a small conversion script: `tools/tokenizer/convert_bos.sh`.
jo: for attn_impl, infra asked us to add an explicit fallback policy in model.yaml: `fallbacks: [cutlass, cpu]` so Dedicated won't try cuda_fallback. I'll draft the patch.
micah: good. what about GQA/MQA flags? any inference changes needed?
ashok: MQA is on. runtime smoke shows ~6% memory reduction but kernel choice matters for latency. I suggest we pin `gqa: true` and test perf with both `attn_impl=flash` and `cutlass` to compare p50/p95.
eva: rolling tokenizer PR now. also noticed sliding_window=2048 may interact poorly with our prefix caching heuristics for long-dialog demos — maybe set sliding_window: 1024 for initial rollout to be safer.
jo: i'll run two quick smoke jobs on staging with rope_scale=0.95 and rope_scale=1.0, attn_impl=flash/cutlass, sliding_window=1024/2048. expect ~30m each.
infra-bot: deploy-checks: model-registry lint: passed with warnings; storage-ACL check: passed; infra-quotas: ephemeral GPUs available: 12/16; ci-smoke queued.
micah: timeline: eva to land tokenizer PR today, jo to post perf numbers in this thread, ashok to add weights path verification step to the onboarding checklist. if any of the smoke runs fail, we fall back to zh-30b-mqa-v1 config.
eva: landed tokenizer shim branch, opening PR 4521 shortly.
jo: starting run now. will post p50/p95 and memory numbers.
ashok: adding weights path sanity check to checklist: `ri-verify-weights --bucket s3://ri-models/zh/30b/mqa/v2/ --expect-shards 16 --checksum-file checksums.sha256`
micah: perfect. thanks all — keep the thread updated and ping me if anything blocks the Dedicated onboarding window. :thumbsup:
